11:72 · 011 Hud

قَالَتْ يَـٰوَيْلَتَىٰٓ ءَأَلِدُ وَأَنَا۠ عَجُوزٌ وَهَـٰذَا بَعْلِى شَيْخًا ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ

Word in this verse: ءَأَلِدُ — Shall I bear a child

English (Sahih International): She said, "Woe to me! Shall I give birth while I am an old woman and this, my husband, is an old man? Indeed, this is an amazing thing!"

English (Yusuf Ali): She said: "Alas for me! shall I bear a child, seeing I am an old woman, and my husband here is an old man? That would indeed be a wonderful thing!"

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): اس نے کہا اے ہے میرے بچہ ہوگا؟ میں تو بڑھیا ہوں اور میرے میاں بھی بوڑھے ہیں۔ یہ تو بڑی عجیب بات ہے

19:15 · 019 Maryam

وَسَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّا

Word in this verse: وُلِدَ — he was born

English (Sahih International): And peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he dies and the day he is raised alive.

English (Yusuf Ali): So Peace on him the day he was born, the day that he dies, and the day that he will be raised up to life (again)!

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): اور جس دن وہ پیدا ہوئے اور جس دن وفات پائیں گے اور جس دن زندہ کرکے اٹھائے جائیں گے۔ ان پر سلام اور رحمت (ہے)

19:33 · 019 Maryam

وَٱلسَّلَـٰمُ عَلَىَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّا

English (Sahih International): And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive."

English (Yusuf Ali): "So peace is on me the day I was born, the day that I die, and the day that I shall be raised up to life (again)"!

37:152 · 037 As-Saffat

وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ

Word in this verse: وَلَدَ — Allah has begotten

English (Sahih International): "Allāh has begotten," and indeed, they are liars.

English (Yusuf Ali): "Allah has begotten children"? but they are liars!

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): کہ خدا کے اولاد ہے کچھ شک نہیں کہ یہ جھوٹے ہیں

58:2 · 058 Al-Mujadila

ٱلَّذِينَ يُظَـٰهِرُونَ مِنكُم مِّن نِّسَآئِهِم مَّا هُنَّ أُمَّهَـٰتِهِمْ ۖ إِنْ أُمَّهَـٰتُهُمْ إِلَّا ٱلَّـٰٓـِٔى وَلَدْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَقُولُونَ مُنكَرًا مِّنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَزُورًا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌ

Word in this verse: وَلَدْنَهُمْ ۚ — gave them birth

English (Sahih International): Those who pronounce ẓihār among you [to separate] from their wives - they are not [consequently] their mothers. Their mothers are none but those who gave birth to them. And indeed, they are saying an objectionable statement and a falsehood. But indeed, Allāh is Pardoning and Forgiving.

English (Yusuf Ali): If any men among you divorce their wives by Zihar (calling them mothers), they cannot be their mothers: None can be their mothers except those who gave them birth. And in fact they use words (both) iniquitous and false: but truly Allah is one that blots out (sins), and forgives (again and again).

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): جو لوگ تم میں سے اپنی عورتوں کو ماں کہہ دیتے ہیں وہ ان کی مائیں نہیں (ہوجاتیں)۔ ان کی مائیں تو وہی ہیں جن کے بطن سے وہ پیدا ہوئے۔ بےشک وہ نامعقول اور جھوٹی بات کہتے ہیں اور خدا بڑا معاف کرنے والا (اور) بخشنے والا ہے

71:27 · 071 Nuh

إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا

Word in this verse: يَلِدُوٓا۟ — they will beget

English (Sahih International): Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.

English (Yusuf Ali): "For, if Thou dost leave (any of) them, they will but mislead Thy devotees, and they will breed none but wicked ungrateful ones.

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): اگر تم ان کو رہنے دے گا تو تیرے بندوں کو گمراہ کریں گے اور ان سے جو اولاد ہوگی وہ بھی بدکار اور ناشکر گزار ہوگی

90:3 · 090 Al-Balad

وَوَالِدٍ وَمَا وَلَدَ

Word in this verse: وَلَدَ — he begot

English (Sahih International): And [by] the father and that which was born [of him],

English (Yusuf Ali): And (the mystic ties of) parent and child;-

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): اور باپ (یعنی آدم) اور اس کی اولاد کی قسم

112:3 · 112 Al-Ikhlas

لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ

Word in this verse: يَلِدْ — He begets

English (Sahih International): He neither begets nor is born,

English (Yusuf Ali): He begetteth not, nor is He begotten;

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): نہ کسی کا باپ ہے اور نہ کسی کا بیٹا
